description: tools/test-projects/splines (WEB_PROJECT=splines tools/build.sh web): a 1.2 km Crown road generated on the CPU and drawn in WebGL2, a follower on it, and a knot moved from Lua 1.5 s in. Without pthreads the rebuild's chunks are Background jobs the engine pumps 4 ms a frame: every frame's spline work stays within 4 ms and the rebuild ends within 10 frames (S18 R17, AC17); an error line otherwise. The canvas centre is the road's grey.
